abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.description: Every 18 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack deals 125 bonus Spell Damage. Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

fields.notes: This damage will also miss and set the Trait back on full cooldown if a Basic Attack misses while this effect is available (because of Varian being Blinded or the target Evading).

abilities.name: Lion's Fang
abilities.description: Create a shockwave that travels in a straight line, dealing 150 damage and Slowing enemies by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy hit heals Varian for 35, increased to 140 against Heroes.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 10 Parry all incoming Basic Attacks for 1.25 seconds, reducing their damage by 100%. Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge to the target enemy, dealing 50 damage and Slowing them by 75% for 1 second.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash
fields.notes: If there is an unpathable area between Varian and the target, Varian will try to dash around it until Charge reaches its maximum duration of 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds. Passive Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

fields.notes: The effect ends immediately if Varian dies. Cannot be cast on enemy Heroes who are immune to crowd control.

abilities.name: Colossus Smash
abilities.description: Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage. Passive Base Attack Damage increased by 100%. Passive Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Defensive damage modifier / Movement: Launch, Offensive damage modifier, Health modifier
fields.notes: Cast is interrupted if the distance between Varian and the target becomes greater than 12 units or the target instantly teleports farther than 12 units from their previous location. Armor reduction does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Attack damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can attack Varian's Attack Damage.

abilities.name: Twin Blades of Fury
abilities.description: Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by 9 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Passive Attack Speed increased by 100%. Passive Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.; Heroic

fields.notes: Attack Speed increase stacks additively with other Attack Speed modifiers. Damage penalty stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Varian's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Lion's Maw
talents.description: quest Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175. After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.
_raw_fields: quest Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175. After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

talents.name: Overpower
talents.description: When you Parry a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Heroic Strike 's damage.

_raw_fields: When you Parry a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

talents.name: High King's Quest
talents.description: questonly Hit 50 Heroes with Basic Attacks. questonly Participate in 5 Hero Takedowns. questonly Gather 15 Regeneration Globes. reward Completing a Quest grants 10 Base Attack Damage. Completing all 3 Quests grants an additional 30 Base Attack Damage.

fields.notes: Completing all three quests grants a total of 60 bonus Basic Attack damage. Bonus damage is affected by damage modifiers, including Colossus Smash and Twin Blades of Furys' passive multipliers.

talents.name: Lionheart
talents.description: Increase Lion Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with healing modifiers that can affect Lion's Fang 's healing output and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received by the target.

_raw_fields: Increase Lion Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

fields.notes: Does not heal from Heroic Strike damage.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

talents.name: Victory Rush
talents.description: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, this cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

fields.notes: Monster deaths only trigger the cooldown reduction if killed by Varian. Effect will not trigger nor be put on cooldown if the attack misses due to being Blinded or target Evading. Minion deaths within 12 radius trigger the cooldown reduction.

_raw_fields: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, this cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

talents.name: Shield Wall
talents.description: Parry now grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage for the duration. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

fields.notes: Protected replaces Evasion after taking this Talent.

_raw_fields: Parry now grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage for the duration. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

talents.name: Warbringer
talents.description: Reduces Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 25. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

fields.notes: Charging to allied Heroes neither damages nor Slows them.

_raw_fields: Reduces Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 25. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

talents.name: Juggernaut
talents.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.
_raw_fields: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
talents.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with modifiers that affect healing received, and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing dealt.

_raw_fields: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Shattering Throw
talents.description: cooldown 30 Active Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50 damage, and up to 1400 bonus damage to their Shields. Passive Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.

fields.notes: Passive Basic Attack damage multiplier does not affect Heroic Strike. Passive Shield damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Varian's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Banner of Stormwind
talents.description: cooldown 25 Active Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds. Banner Stormwind Aura

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Movement Speed effects, such as Twin Blades of Fury's Movement Speed bonus, unless otherwise specified by the Ability in question.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

fields.notes: Spell Power stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting target Heroes' Spell Damage or healing output.

talents.name: Vigilance
talents.description: Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.
_raw_fields: Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.

talents.name: Master at Arms
talents.description: Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

fields.notes: Structures can be affected by the splash damage.

_raw_fields: Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

talents.name: Frenzy
talents.description: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Heroic Strike 's damage.

_raw_fields: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Glory to the Alliance
talents.description: Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other healing modifiers that affect healing received, and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing dealt (such as Banner of Dalaran).

talents.name: Demoralizing Shout
talents.description: cooldown 20 Active Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds. Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that affect the target Heroes' damage output.
